Likely relegation battlers Al Kholood continue the 2026-27 Saudi Pro League season with the visit of a steady Al Ettifaq side on Saturday.

Kick-off date/time: [...] Al Kholood had started the season with three victories and three draws in their opening six matches but that fine start has since been undermined with three successive defeats; beaten 3-2 by Al Faisaly in their most recent outing the other day.

Al Ettifaq come into this one on the back of a 4-1 hammering at the hands of Al Ittihad. That came after a steady run of form which does mean they begin the match day sitting a place above Al Kholood in the middle-of-the-table.
